posts.description: 1 to 5 posts, each at most 280 characters

image_brief.description: Visual brief for an illustration of this post: subject, setting, mood, composition. No people, no text, no logos.

claim.description: A factual statement used in the text

source_quote.description: Exact quote from the source or brand facts that supports it

used_facts.description: Every fact, number, date, price, name or promise used in the text, with its support

uncertain.description: Places the editor should double-check (ambiguous or weakly supported statements)
